name: Bulk quote actions
description:
## POST /api/v1/quotes/bulk

Performs bulk actions on an array of quotes
whenToUse: Run a batch action (approve, convert, send_email, mark_sent) over an array of quote ids; use for multi-quote operations (mutating).

queryParameters.name: index
queryParameters.description:
Replaces the default response index from data to a user specific string

ie.

```html
  ?index=new_index
```

response is wrapped

```json
  {
    'new_index' : [
      .....
    ]
  }
```

fields.name: action
fields.description:
The action to be performed, options include:
- `approve`
  Bulk approve an array of quotes
- `convert`
  Bulk convert an array of quotes to invoices
- `send_email`
  Bulk send an array of quotes as emails
- `mark_sent`
  Bulk mark an array
